description: 放課後の高校の理科室で、3人の生徒が化学実験に取り組んでいる。中央の男子生徒はメスシリンダーを使って青い液体の量を慎重に測り、ビーカーへ注ごうとしている。左側の女子生徒は試験管の中で起きている泡の反応を観察しながらストップウォッチで時間を測っている。右側の女子生徒はタブレットと記録用紙を使って実験結果を整理し、簡単なグラフにまとめている。机にはビーカー、試験管、スポイト、温度計、保護メガネなどが整理され、安全に実験している様子が分かる。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three Japanese high school students conducting a chemistry experiment in a bright modern school science laboratory after school. Do not include any additional visible students, teachers, or other people. All three students should wear school uniforms, white laboratory coats, and protective safety goggles. The atmosphere should be scientific, focused, cooperative, safe, and positive. In the center foreground, a teenage boy is carefully measuring blue-colored laboratory liquid in a graduated cylinder. He is holding the graduated cylinder at eye level to check the measurement and is preparing to pour the liquid into a clear glass beaker on the laboratory table. The graduated cylinder, blue liquid, beaker, and measurement markings must be clearly visible. On the left side, a teenage girl is observing a chemical reaction inside a test tube held securely in a test-tube rack. Small harmless bubbles are forming inside the test tube. She is holding a digital stopwatch in one hand and watching the reaction carefully, clearly timing how long it takes. On the right side, another teenage girl is recording the results. She has a tablet correctly positioned with the screen facing her, a paper data sheet, and a pencil. She is comparing the experimental measurements and creating a simple graph or table on the tablet. Make the three roles visually distinct and easy to describe: one student measuring and pouring liquid, one observing and timing a bubbling reaction, and one recording and organizing experimental data. Include a laboratory table, several clean beakers, test tubes in a rack, graduated cylinders, droppers, a thermometer, digital stopwatch, tablet, clipboard, pencils, safety goggles, disposable gloves, wash bottle, laboratory sink, shelves containing scientific glassware, and a simple experiment diagram on a whiteboard showing icons for liquid, temperature, time, and results without important readable text. Keep all chemical reactions small, controlled, and completely safe: no explosions, no dangerous smoke, no fire, and no broken glass. Warm late-afternoon sunlight should enter through classroom windows. Exactly three visible people. No additional people, no animals, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style with realistic proportions, highly detailed but visually organized and uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

chunks.ja: 実験室で安全に作業する

sentences.text: The three students are conducting a chemistry experiment in the school laboratory.
sentences.ja: 3人の生徒が学校の実験室で化学実験をしています。

sentences.text: The boy is measuring the amount of blue liquid in a graduated cylinder.
sentences.ja: 男子生徒はメスシリンダーの青い液体の量を測っています。

sentences.text: He appears to be checking the measurement before pouring the liquid.
sentences.ja: 彼は液体を注ぐ前に測定値を確認しているようです。

sentences.text: One girl is observing bubbles forming inside a test tube.
sentences.grammar: 現在分詞による後置修飾
sentences.ja: 一人の女子生徒は試験管の中にできている泡を観察しています。

sentences.text: She is using a stopwatch to measure how long the reaction takes.
sentences.ja: 彼女は反応にどのくらい時間がかかるか測るためにストップウォッチを使っています。

sentences.text: The other girl is recording the experimental results on a tablet.
sentences.ja: もう一人の女子生徒はタブレットに実験結果を記録しています。

sentences.text: She appears to be organizing the information into a simple graph.
sentences.ja: 彼女は情報を簡単なグラフにまとめているようです。

sentences.text: Their safety goggles suggest that they are following laboratory safety rules.
sentences.ja: 保護メガネを着用していることから、実験室の安全ルールを守っていることが分かります。

chunks.ja: 管理された実験を行う

sentences.text: The three students are carrying out a controlled chemistry experiment in which each member is responsible for a different stage of the procedure.
sentences.ja: 3人の生徒は、それぞれが異なる実験工程を担当しながら管理された化学実験を行っています。

sentences.text: The male student is carefully quantifying the volume of a blue solution before transferring it into a beaker.
sentences.ja: 男子生徒は青い溶液をビーカーへ移す前に、その体積を注意深く測定しています。

sentences.text: Holding the graduated cylinder at eye level suggests that he is attempting to obtain a precise measurement.
sentences.ja: メスシリンダーを目の高さに合わせていることから、正確な測定値を得ようとしていることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: One of his classmates is monitoring a bubbling reaction while using a stopwatch to quantify its duration.
sentences.ja: クラスメートの一人は、ストップウォッチで反応時間を測定しながら泡の発生する反応を観察しています。

sentences.text: Her focused expression indicates that the timing of the reaction is an important experimental variable.
sentences.ja: 彼女の集中した表情から、反応時間が重要な実験変数であることが分かります。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the third student is documenting their observations and organizing the quantitative data on a tablet.
sentences.ja: その一方で、3人目の生徒は観察結果を記録し、数値データをタブレット上で整理しています。

sentences.text: She appears to be converting the collected measurements into a graph so that the results can be compared more easily.
sentences.ja: 彼女は結果をより簡単に比較できるよう、収集した測定値をグラフに変換しているようです。

sentences.text: The protective goggles, organized glassware, and controlled reaction indicate that the students are following appropriate laboratory safety procedures.
sentences.ja: 保護メガネ、整理された実験器具、制御された反応から、生徒たちが適切な実験室の安全手順に従っていることが分かります。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how scientific investigation requires precise measurement, careful observation, systematic documentation, and interpretation of evidence.
sentences.ja: この場面は、科学的な調査には正確な測定、注意深い観察、体系的な記録、そして証拠の解釈が必要であることを示しています。
